newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Candover MBO has 210 mln stg bankfunding.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Candover MBO has 210 mln stg bankfunding.

text.p: LONDON, December 4 (LPC) - Candover has obtained 210 million stg in bank financing to help fund the management buyout (MBO) it is leading of 15 businesses from Williams Holdings, according to a banker close to the deal.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is arranging the loan.

Newmond Limited, the new company formed by the MBO, will pay a total consideration of 360 million stg for the European heating, construction and home products units of Williams. Candover, along with Electra Fleming and Alpinvest Holding, will provide the equity finance. Williams is to retain a 26 percent stake in Newmond.
NatWest Markets have underwritten a third of the bank debt, with Deutsche holding the balance.
The eight-year credit is split between a 185 million stg term loan and a 25 million revolving credit. Pricing is set at 200 bps over LIBOR rising to 225 bps in the 8th year.
Funding will occur before the end of the year and syndication is expected early in 1997.
